mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.refresh_token ( account_no, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_revoked ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{updatedBy}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{isRevoked}, FALSE) )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id AS tokenId, account_no AS accountNo, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, is_revoked AS isRevoked FROM common.refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT token_id AS tokenId, account_no AS accountNo, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, is_revoked AS isRevoked FROM common.refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE common.refresh_token SET is_revoked = TRUE, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND is_revoked = FALSE
UPDATE common.refresh_token SET is_revoked = TRUE, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND is_revoked = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM common.refresh_token WHERE expires_at < NOW()
